artworks.title: Victory Parade
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of figures on horseback along with soldiers and individuals holding various tools or weapons. The image depicts stylized figures in a folk art style, characterized by simple, flat colors and absence of depth perception. The figures on horseback are in a side profile view with swords. Below, there are soldiers standing with sabers and rifles, dressed in uniforms with peaked hats and two-tone jackets and trousers. Additional figures with various tools and individuals in patterned attire are also present. The composition emphasizes an organized, regimented scene typical of early American folk paintings used to celebrate military engagement or daily life scenes.

artworks.title: George Edward Blake
artworks.medium: pastel on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated at a slight angle. He has dark hair styled upwards and forward, with some strands falling onto his forehead. His facial features include a smooth complexion, gently arched eyebrows, and a neutral expression. He wears a white cravat and a dark coat with a high collar. He is holding a folded piece of paper with writing visible on it. The background is a neutral tone with subtle shading.

artworks.title: Anna Margaret Blake and Her Two Children
artworks.medium: pastel
artworks.dimensions: sight size: 70 x 55 cm (27 9/16 x 21 5/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The portrait depicts a woman seated with two young children on her lap. The woman is facing the viewer with her shoulders turned to the right. She has a serene expression with dark hair styled up and is wearing a light-colored dress. One child is an infant wearing a cap and gown, while the other child wears a sleeveless dress and looks upwards. Both children have necklaces, and the woman is wearing earrings. The background is a muted, dark color with abstract shapes.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man Holding a Book
artworks.medium: pastel on paper sheet backed by several layers of paper, the last of which is newsprint bearing the date 1823
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows an individual from the chest up, positioned slightly to the side but facing forward. The person has dark, neatly combed hair and a calm gaze. They are wearing a dark jacket over a white shirt with a high collar, and holding a book with a brown cover below chest level against their body. The background is a solid muted green color.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman with a Lace Cap
artworks.medium: pastel on paper sheet backed by several layers of paper, the last of which is newsprint bearing the date 1823
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated in a chair. She is facing forward and has a direct gaze at the viewer. She has light-colored eyes, fair complexion, and small curls of brown hair visible under her white lace-trimmed cap. She wears a high-collared black garment with voluminous sleeves and a lace collar matching her cap. She holds a small brown book in her hands, placed on her lap. The background is a plain, muted green.

artworks.title: Child with Pet Dog
artworks.medium: pastel on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The person in the image is seated on a wooden chair facing forward. They have a round face with fair skin, large blue eyes, a small nose, and full lips. They are wearing a lace cap with a bow, a light blue or gray dress with lace trim, and pink slip-on shoes. They are holding a small dog with short beige fur and dark markings, curled tail, in their lap. The background is a simple, muted green color.

artworks.title: Two Grotesque Heads
artworks.artist: Francesco Melzi after Leonardo da Vinci
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Edward Fowles
artworks.description: An older man and woman with exaggerated facial features are shown from the chest up as they face each other in profile in this horizontal drawing on tan paper. To our left, the woman has a protruding, deeply wrinkled face with a blunt nose, squinting eyes, and a dramatically downturned mouth. Loose folds of skin sag down her neck and chest. She wears a C-shaped headdress with a loosely drawn veil hanging down the back. A delicate flower sticks out of the ample, wrinkled decolletage encased in her low-cut bodice. The man opposite her has deep-set eyes over a long, hooked nose and a lumpy, potato-like chin jutting out from his craggy face. His hair is covered by a headdress with a padded brim. A long scarf drapes over his head and across his chest. His shoulders and back are suggested by a few short pen strokes.

artworks.title: Apollo
artworks.medium: black chalk and stumping, heightened with white chalk on greenish-gray laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith

artworks.title: Crêpes
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over traces of graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith

artworks.title: A Nude Woman Reaching to the Right
artworks.medium: black chalk with stumping, heightened with white chalk on brown laid paper (formerly blue)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith
artworks.description: This drawing displays a person lying on their front with their upper body slightly raised, their head turned to the right, and both arms extended outward. Their back and the upper part of their legs are visible. The person's facial features are not fully visible, and they have hair styled in a bun. The person is not wearing any clothing, but there appears to be a cloth beneath them. The lines of the drawing are in white and gray against a tan background.

artworks.title: Goatherd Piping to Four Goats
artworks.medium: etching on blue paper with white heightening
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Helmut H. Rumbler
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with goats and a shepherd. The image shows a group of goats resting and lounging on the ground. The drawing features goats in the foreground, one seated and another standing, both with distinctive horns. The setting appears to be outdoors with a crumbling stone wall partially visible. There are tall trees and foliage in the background, suggesting a rural landscape. The textures, such as the goats' fur and the stone wall, add depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Sidon
artworks.medium: graphite on greenish wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert S. Pirie
artworks.description: The image shows a seaside view sketched with pencil on tan paper. The composition includes a beach leading to the sea, buildings with a tall tower on the left, and faintly sketched sailboats in the distance on the right. The pencil strokes are delicate and create a serene atmosphere with a muted color palette of gray tones.

artworks.title: Portrait of an Old Woman
artworks.medium: black crayon and graphite heightened with white  on green wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert S. Pirie
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman seated, facing slightly to the right and looking directly at the viewer. She has a round face with dark hair styled under a white bonnet. She is wearing a dark garment with a white lace collar and a light-colored bow fastened with a brooch around her neck. The background is a simple, shaded area that gradually fades into the neutral tone of the paper.

artworks.title: Tree and Foliage
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert S. Pirie
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil drawing of a woodland scene with a viewpoint at ground level. The dense forest environment fills the composition, focused on the details of trees and foliage surrounding a path that stretches into the distance. The drawing features delicate and textured pencil strokes capturing the complexity of leaves and bark, varying from soft lines for background foliage to darker strokes for closer bark. The monochromatic color palette of varying shades of gray enhances the depth of the scene. The shadows and highlights add depth, guiding the eye along the receding path.

artworks.title: Landscape with Alpheus and Arethusa
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a dense forest scene with tall, expansive trees with thick canopies. The horizon is not visible due to the surrounding foliage. The artwork uses detailed brushstrokes to depict texture in the foliage and bark, capturing the play of light and shadow in the forest canopy. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black and white. Two figures are depicted in the scene, one emerging from water and another in motion. The background is filled with trees and branches. The artwork conveys depth and complexity of the natural environment.

artworks.title: Landscape with Tobias and the Angel
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rocky terrain, a stream, dense foliage, and trees. In the background, there are human figures on a rocky outcrop, a fortified town or castle, and hills. The artwork is done using intricate brushstrokes, creating detailed patterns. The color palette is mainly brown, typical of an engraved artwork. The sky is depicted with subtle cloud-like line work and a few birds.

artworks.title: Evening
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on Japanese paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene from an elevated viewpoint, showing a countryside landscape with a stream, trees, reeds, and cows. The horizon is low in the composition, with a sky filled with swirling clouds. The artwork features intricate brushstrokes and a monochromatic palette of browns and blacks.

artworks.title: Landscape with Wagon
artworks.artist: John Browne after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This image depicts a lush, wooded landscape from a slightly elevated viewpoint. Two oxen pull a wooden cart along a winding path through a dense forest of mature trees. The artwork uses detailed lines and cross-hatching to convey texture and depth of the scene. In the distance, the horizon shows a continuation of the forested landscape stretching into rolling hills. The sky is lightly clouded, contrasting with the intricate tree patterns below. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of grey and black. The dense arrangement of trees dominates the image, emphasizing the natural environment depicted.

artworks.title: Old Man with Bare Head
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up portrait of a person's head and shoulders. The person is turning slightly to the left, with the left side of their face more prominently visible. They have distinct facial features including a prominent nose, thick eyebrows, and deep-set eyes. The person has a full, long beard and wavy hair framing their face. The hair looks textured and unkempt. They are wearing a dark, heavy garment around the shoulders. The background is dark and textured, contrasting with the lighter tones of the person's face and hair.

artworks.title: Hudson Highlands
artworks.medium: graphite with touches of white heightening on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection, Avalon Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts an aerial view overlooking a body of water. The horizon is positioned high, showing water meeting distant land and the sky. Mountains or hills are subtly indicated in the distance with light pencil lines. The drawing style is loose with delicate strokes defining the rocky landscape. The color scheme is monochromatic, with various shades of gray on beige paper. The water reflects minimal detail, suggesting a calm scene, with small sailboats adding points of interest.

artworks.title: Magdalena River, New Granada, Equador
artworks.medium: graphite heightened with white on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection, Avalon Fund

artworks.title: Temple of Juno, Agrigentum
artworks.medium: graphite and white chalk on gray laid paper
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection, Avalon Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with an elevated point of view. Near us on the left, there are remnants of an ancient structure with tall, fluted columns. The horizon is low, emphasizing the sky and distant landscape. The horizon fades into hills or mountains in the distance. The brushwork is delicate with detailed lines and soft shading. The color palette consists of muted cream and soft grays on tan paper. To the right, there are trees and a distant city on a hill, adding depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Villa d'Este, Tivoli
artworks.medium: graphite with touches of white heightening and brown wash on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection, Avalon Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a ground-level view looking at a building behind a row of tall trees. The trees are tightly packed, leading towards the distant building. The horizon is hidden by the trees and the building. The building has a classical design with detailed windows and an ornate entrance. The artwork has delicate brushstrokes and a soft, sketch-like quality. The color scheme is dominated by muted sepia and brown tones. Light and shadows create depth as the view approaches the building amidst the trees.

artworks.title: Breezing Up
artworks.medium: graphite highlighted with black crayon and white chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection, Avalon Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a side view of a small sailboat with four people on board. The horizon is high in the composition, with another sailboat visible in the distance on the right. The drawing has a soft, sketch-like style with visible pencil strokes. The color palette is minimalistic, consisting mainly of brown and black tones on brown paper. The water is represented with dynamic strokes, and the figures are detailed with defined lines.
